consumer: The engine's detection/targeting eligibility check (Character::sees(Creature)) asking 'can the avatar currently see this specific monster?'
scope: Per-monster line-of-sight/visibility from the avatar (computed LOS predicate), not rectangular proximity-window membership
decisive_source: Character::sees(const Creature&) (creature visibility predicate) — computes whether the viewer has line of sight to the target given light, range, obstacles, and stealth; the engine-computed value is the authority
divergence: A monster standing inside the export window but behind a wall: in_export_window includes it so the surface reports it as present/visible, but sees() returns false because there is no line of sight — the avatar cannot actually detect/target it
